## Goal
A short page for the moment the app says a listing "reappeared" (`CHIP_LABEL`, `src/freemyid/wizard/ui.py:29`): what it means, why it happens (sites buy and copy data; `docs/USER_GUIDE.md` section 9 and line 44), what Free My ID does next (a new request on the next real run; the escalation steps start over, `src/freemyid/state.py:56-62`, `state.py:79-81`), and what the person can do now. It must agree with the user guide and the glossary entry "Reappeared" (`docs/user/GLOSSARY.md:60`) and not contradict WO-358's page on sites that ignore a request.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. Under 450 words, reading level grade 8 or lower, short sentences, no fear wording ("normal" is allowed, "dangerous" is not).
2. Says what the person sees (the label "reappeared", quoted exactly from `ui.py:29`), what happens next, and the one thing they can do (nothing is required; they can open the broker page from the card if they want to look).
3. Explains the difference from "site confirmed" and "not listed now" using the labels in `ui.py:22-30`.
4. Never promises a result or a date; says "requested", never "erased".
5. Matches the user guide section 9 and the glossary entry (a test or a manual check listed in VENDOR_STATUS.md).
6. Every label quoted exists in the app with file:line in an HTML comment.
7. Linked from `docs/user/help-topics.md` by in-house after merge (note it in VENDOR_STATUS.md).

**Limits (every Grok WO, CLAUDE-G-004):** offline only. No network, credentials, git or gh, installs, or running the real app against real sites or a real mailbox; never read anything outside the repo. Fake people only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Tests pass on Windows too (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`). Check `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/`, `tests/grok/` and the in-house `tests/test_*.py` first; don't duplicate a guard.
